method: outline via bmesh boundary edges of the 256-px silhouette face grid; 400 arc-length samples; turning angle over +-4 samples; + convex, - concave; z = 0 at figure top, 1 at bottom

cross_view_agreement.verdict: front and profile agree; references are a consistent turnaround

instrument_finding.at_128px: mean |turn| is pixel-staircase dominated (ref 30.1 vs melted hull 28.8); only tails discriminate (max convex 177 vs 150 front, 175 vs 116 profile; min concave -160 vs -129, -131 vs -90)
instrument_finding.rule: measure curvature on >=512-px outlines rendered through the calibrated camera (or sub-pixel edges), turning window ~2% of contour length; compare feature lists (z, kind, magnitude), not means

gate: a model may be rendered for human review only after its per-view feature lists match the reference spec within tolerance (z +-0.02, kind, magnitude class) AND its own views agree on shared landmarks (neck row, eye line) the way the references do
